<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex070032026-10-1509-10-15" status="unreviewed"> <milestone n="1. gzhan lugs dgag pa" unit="section"/>
            dang po ni 
               <milestone n="a. lo tsA ba" unit="section"/>
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA ba</rs> na re | rnal 'byor mngon sum mo zhes gsungs pa ltar na mthong spang sa bon las grol bar thal | rnal 'byor mngon sum mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir | khyab pa yod de | yang dag <lb n="52a8"/> mthong na rnam par grol || zhes pa'i phyir ro || 'dod na cha mthun yin pa nyams so || 
            <milestone n="b. ar" unit="section"/>
            yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">ar</rs> na re chos nyid la sgro 'dogs gcod byed rnal 'byor mngon sum rjes su mthun pa'o zhes zer ba de ci | sgro 'dogs mngon 'gyur gcod byed dam 'on de sa bon gcod byed yin | dang po'o zhe na |
            de de yin no zhes brjod pas na lan brjod pa ma yin no || gnyis pa'o zhe na rnal 'byor mngon sum rjes mthun par 'dod pa  <lb n="52a9"/> nyams ste sa bon gcod byed yin pa'i phyir dper na mo gsham zhes brjod pa bzhin no || </seg></TEI>
